changelog: One-click self-update from /admin (disk-backed state so the log survives the restart, detached spawn, 409 on double-click), release tarballs ship scripts/, a repo layout for update.sh so an install in a git checkout restarts via launchd instead of silently updating a binary nobody runs, plus fixes: Claude fallbackModel no longer downgrades a session, coalesced config saves no longer race a torn-down directory, Usage names API keys, Recent Requests no longer scrolls sideways
